title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: MaryRose Mazzola is an attorney, public policy expert, and political professional with nearly fifteen years of experience across government and equity-focused nonprofits. She currently serves as Senior Vice President, Director of External Affairs at Eastern Bank and the Eastern Bank Foundation, the $250M charitable arm of Eastern Bank providing support to historically marginalized communities. In this role, she helps lead both organizations’ policy research, advocacy, and coalition work and serves as a senior advisor to Executive Chair Bob Rivers in his civic leadership endeavors.
